endorsements.quote: Assess, report and discuss the correctness of explanations benchmarked against the ground truth as it is done for quantifying predictive accuracy of a model

To evaluate the plausibility of explanations, developers or users should assess how well the explanation aligns with the clinician’s mental model-speci fically in terms of domain relevance (i.e., pertinence to the clinical task), coherence, and actionability10,22,23-within the context of the specificc a s ea th a n d( T a b l e2).
Report XAI performance and limitations clearly.

When using XAI in practice: a. Use clinical judgement to evaluate explanation coherence. b. Be aware of XAI limitations. c. Be aware of data quality used by XAI system. d. Treat XAI output only as an adjunct.

unlisted_practices: Report the purpose for which explanations are developed and intended when deploying explainable AI.
Quantify and report the confidence or uncertainty of explanations using bootstrapping or repeated model training.
Quantify and report the consistency of explanations across design variations, cohort-level feature agreement, and patient-level sign agreement.
Evaluate explanations for alignment with causal baselines if they are used to capture causal relationships, and state that non-causal explanations cannot guide intervention choices.
Use explanations together with fairness metrics to explore model bias and fairness and report findings.
Analyse the data distributions of main explanation contributors for correct and incorrect predictions and report how this informed model improvement.
Involve multiple domain experts when rating explanation relevance, coherence, and actionability using standardised rating scales.
Display only highly relevant, actionable variables on dashboards intended for end-users.
Report ensemble XAI methods and how final explanations are obtained when used to improve explanation robustness.

screen.reason: The paper introduces CLIX-M, a clinician-informed checklist/framework for standardized evaluation and reporting of explainable AI (XAI) in clinical decision support systems.
